name: Ergometrine (ergonovine)
mechanism: Stimulates uterine smooth muscle causing sustained contraction
dosing: IM/IV bolus for postpartum haemorrhage as per protocol; IV should be given slowly with monitoring
contraindications: Hypertension, pre-eclampsia, cardiac disease, sepsis, pregnancy for labour augmentation
monitoring: BP, uterine tone, signs of ischemia
pregnancy: Used postpartum for PPH; contraindicated for induction of labour in hypertensive disease
clinicalPearls: Use with caution in cardiac disease; often second-line or adjunct to oxytocin
